data.long_meaning: In Greek, Mnason means 'graceful aid'. This name is derived from the Greek elements 'mnēmē' (mind, memory) and 'asthēnō' (to be strong or powerful). Mnason is a name for a person who provides support and assistance to others. The name Mnason carries the meaning “Graceful aid” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mnason usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful aid and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mnason total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: Mnason holds a significant place in the New Testament of the Bible as a Christian disciple and a welcoming host to Paul and Barnabas during their missionary journey (Acts 16:1-5). He extends warm hospitality to these early Christian leaders and endorses their message to his household. The virtue of hospitality as portrayed in the character of Mnason highlights the importance of community and fellowship in Christianity. It also underlines the need for Christians to serve, support, and nurture each other, just as Mnason did.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mnason is a reminder of the spiritual principle that every Christian is called to serve others. It reflects the idea of providing spiritual fraternity, support, and aid to those in need, mirroring the graceful aid Mnason extended. This name can be an inspiration for individuals to embody the characteristics of a compassionate, caring, and selfless person, following the teachings of Jesus. Mnason's meaning can serve as a personal reminder to extend kindness, love, and assistance to others, just as he did to Paul and Barnabas.
